correctness.rationale: PASS: Assumptions are n students/n unit-capacity schools, independent uniform complete strict preferences, independent uniform school priorities for student-proposing DA and uniform serial order for RSD. An earlier serial chooser cannot envy a later chooser. For marked RSD serial positions K, at time t each later chooser must prefer one of n-t+1 available schools to the a_t=|K∩{1,...,t-1}| previously selected marked schools, giving conditional probability (n-t+1)/(n-t+1+a_t). Identical hazard holds for first-appearance-ranked coupon types staying singletons until cover. Equality of all subset-inclusion probabilities implies joint indicator-vector equality by Boolean inclusion-exclusion; telescoping gives r!/product_{s=1}^r(n-k_s+s). DA has the already-known coupon singleton representation under the exact random market model, so full unenvied-count distributions agree. Pair covariance and variance follow from r=1,2, with harmonic asymptotics and factorial moments giving Exp(1) after log n normalization. Independent exhaustive RSD n=4 checked 331776 profiles, every one of 15 nonempty inclusion subsets, and full distribution (97,97,67,27)/288.
